testcase.name: Playback controls are M2's: paused frames do not change; seek moves; negative rate plays backwards; zero rate freezes; restart and resume
Signed zero: local ticks of -0.0 are reported as +0.0 and evaluated as the scene start
Scene window: local < 0 is BEFORE (empty), [0, lifetime) is ACTIVE, local >= lifetime is AFTER (empty, even with HOLD_AFTER layers); UNBOUNDED never ends; -0.0 counts as 0
The frame reports the playback's local ticks exactly (M2 Playback.localTicks)
Layer passes are half-open (M2): visible at the start, still at nextDown(end), hidden at the end for ACTIVE_ONLY, held at progress 1 for HOLD_AFTER; hidden before a delay

Extreme instants: GAME tick differences that overflow long give ArithmeticException (M2); COSMETIC nanoseconds wrap (M2); non-finite local ticks give ArithmeticException; huge finite local ticks are evaluated
Ping-pong and loops: cycle and progress are M2's; a held ping-pong with an even cycle count ends at progress 0
Domains: the playback anchor and the instant must both have the scene's domain (IllegalArgumentException), GAME and COSMETIC alike
